C9_strongest_alternative.analysis: Most plausible self-dealing vectors checked against artifacts: (1) WEAK CONTROL — G6 block-shuffle seed 20260923 is hard-coded in the frozen engine, NOT preregistered in the plan text; a post-hoc seed could in principle select a weak control draw. Mitigations: single fixed seed for all shuffles, deterministic and disclosed pre-PnL, and the shuffle preserves the marginal scale/state distribution (blocks of 30 H4 bars); residual risk LOW, recorded as finding F-A7-6. (2) RAZOR VETO — lane B vetoed at |rho|=0.20509 vs bar 0.20 (2.5% over); A7 re-ran the measurement byte-identically, so the number is real, and the veto direction REDUCES the campaign from 12 to 8 cells (fewer trials = anti-selection, not cherry-picking); the veto applies the plan's own pre-registered G11 bar. Honest. (3) MEASURED-FUNDING FAVORITISM — the measured law (7.824x the constant on mean drag) is applied inside the scored run to EVERY arm AND every re-run baseline under both laws (freeze reference_computations includes baseline re-runs; plan §3 lane D), and a baseline-rank change under measured funding is pre-declared a first-class finding — so no book is priced against constant-law baselines while itself on measured law. The law is exposure-proportional, not lane-targeted. No artifact contradicts this. (4) The only defect found that could bias a scored run is the broken measured-funding loader — and its failure mode is a LOUD crash (fail-closed), not silent mispricing (see F-A7-1).

findings.detail: The frozen engine's measured-funding loader cannot execute: es1_engine.load_funding_measured (scripts/es1_engine.py:71) calls Path(FUNDING_DIR).glob(...) but pathlib.Path is NEVER imported in the module — raises NameError: name 'Path' is not defined (reproduced by A7). This is the engine's only staged loader for the lane D measured funding series; P4 must price EVERY cell and baseline under BOTH funding laws (plan §3 lane D, §7 denominator cell×tier×funding_law). As frozen, the scored run crashes at the first measured-law pricing or forces post-freeze engine edits. A7 verified the defect is loader-only: feeding an externally built 7,305-row funding frame into simulate(funding_law='measured') executes correctly. No fixture covers the measured-law path. Remedy (owner/A1, not A7): add the import, add a measured-law fixture, re-run fixtures + dry run, re-freeze engine SHA.

Fixture gap: test_scale_cap_and_zero_when_unknown applies the cap inside the test body (np.minimum(1.0, np.nan_to_num(dec))) and therefore never exercises es1_engine.sig_vol_managed's cap or its non-finite->0 branch. The no-leverage law (plan §8 'fraction <= 1.0 always') is enforced in production code but unproven by the mandatory fixture. Artifact-level backstops exist (dry_run scale_bounds_ok=true over all 13 decision paths; census mean_scale 0.7772/0.9324 <= 1).

Band-hysteresis golden pins the enter threshold (+b), the warmup-flat law and r=0-stays-flat, but contains no golden for exit-from-long stickiness (state=1 held while -b <= r <= b, exit only below -b). The hysteresis ASYMMETRY — lane C's whole mechanism — is only indirectly evidenced (census band-flip monotonicity 223/167/109/81 and the source read of sig_trend_lf).

Warmup-convention divergence between census and engine: feasibility_census.py computes SMA200 on the FULL series then slices the window at bar 153, while the scored engine (es1_dry_run path) computes SMA200 inside the warmup-truncated window (undefined for the first 199 window bars -> flat). Both are causal (no lookahead); impact is limited to census realism (TREND_LF flip counts, band-flip counts, gate occupancy slightly overstate early-window activity vs the scored engine). P4/P5 gates are computed on the scored engine, so no gate is mis-decided; flagged for P4 charter honesty.

G6 block-shuffle seed 20260923 is hard-coded in the frozen engine but is not preregistered in the plan text. It is deterministic, identical across all shuffles, frozen pre-PnL, and the shuffle preserves marginals by construction (30-bar blocks), so post-hoc seed shopping risk is LOW — but the P4 charter should state the seed and its provenance.
